_origin: Template hygiene 7c(2). COMPARTMENT UNIT SYSTEM was keyed ahu and is a built-up (sectional, field-erected) central-station air handling unit. 51 mined items decide it: Compartment Lights Functional (a machine with lights inside is one a person walks into), Assembly of Unit, Access Doors, Eliminators, a filter section with DDC filter control.
_why_not_mapped: Mapping means ~45 conditional rows on the existing ahu template. The Heating Medium pattern is for a handful; 45 is a second checklist hiding inside the first, well past the RTU-vs-AHU bar. A field-erected unit's checklist verifies the assembly that happened on site — a different document from a packaged unit's.
_note: BASE-ONLY, minimal defs. Drafter field-def table rides the next batch, per the air_dryer precedent.

mint.name: Built-Up Air Handling Unit
mint.why: Field-erected from compartments. What is commissioned is the assembly itself — section joints, internal access, interior lighting, acoustic treatment — none of which exists on a factory-packaged unit.

aliases.note: The historical spec name, seeded EXACT-MATCH so the next old specification resolves. Nothing shorter is seeded: 'CU' collides with condensing unit and 'Compartment' alone is not a machine.
